evals.name: save-research
evals.prompt: Save this research finding: I looked into using SQLite vs PostgreSQL for our new microservice. SQLite is simpler but PostgreSQL handles concurrent writes better. Title it 'SQLite vs PostgreSQL for Microservices' and tag it 'database,comparison,microservices'.
evals.expected_output: Artifact written to docs/researches/sqlite-vs-postgresql-for-microservices.md with correct frontmatter, tags, and content

evals.name: find-and-read
evals.prompt: I wrote some notes about API authentication a few days ago. Can you find them and show me what I wrote?
evals.expected_output: Uses fetch or search to locate the artifact, then reads and displays it

evals.name: organize-artifacts
evals.prompt: I have a bunch of research notes in my docs folder. Can you list everything in the researches category and tell me what's there?
evals.expected_output: Uses list command with --category researches and presents the results clearly
